correctness.rationale:
Odd-characteristic bivector Darboux form splits into r symplectic pairs and n-2r zero directions. Each pair contributes a graded length-2 string plus two stationary degree-one vectors; choosing m active pairs gives squarefree complete intersections shifted by r-m. For k

=p Frobenius forces zero. Shifted finite differences R_{ell-1}-(1+T²)R_ell+T²R_{ell+1} count homogeneous string starts. GL/Sp orbit–stabilizer yields rank-frequency factors. Boundaries r=0, n odd, k>=p and nonzero factorial k

value.rationale: Full grade-resolved Jordan strings of multiplication by a two-form are natural intrinsic exterior-algebra invariants, with sharp characteristic-dependent phase change at n=8. Uniform finite binomial formulas for all n,r,p plus frequencies across q-forms provide exact modular Lefschetz and Jordan-stratum data beyond routine rank or weak Lefschetz properties. Classical alternating rank counts are credited rather than treated as novel.
